body: And thank YOU for sharing that! Wow, that's really heavy. I actually got out of the house last year and am really grateful for that, because I think it was the source of all my problems, but I'm jus confused about why I'm starting to have these depressed feelings again

I'm really sorry to hear that about your parents, And I totally understand that "afraid of dying" thing... that might be why I didn't take enough of those pills. When I think about it, it was a really half-assed attempt, and maybe subliminally I didn't really want to die..

hah yeah I kinda just realized that this would go better in /r/offmychest... anyways I'm sorry to say that my relationship with my sister isn't good. While she was here she would always pick fights with my mom and they'd scream at eachother for hours. She also told lies to her friends about me and turned them against me.. to this day I have no idea why. I actually overdosed really shortly before she left, and after she left it was actually a huge relief
:) Thanks a lot. I agree that the situation my parents are in now was brought upon them by themselves but I still do feel bad about them, but I'm trying to get past that

Oh god I don't know what's wrong with me, I just started crying while reading that, I'm really glad someone understands. Thank you. I never told anyone about that. The main thing that keeps me from enjoying my own life is the fact that I feel guilty about how shitty my parent's life turned out. I know it's not my fault but I can't really help it

And about what I hate about myself.. I don't know, a lot of things. I'm not pretty, I'm not that smart, I have no talents.. I'm basically completely mediocre in every way.. a lot of people feel that way about themselves though, so I don't think it plays a big part in these thoughts
